input.rationale: Licensor owns all Licensed Technology and Intellectual Property Rights (Article III), and enhancements/customization work we commission and pay for under Article VII(b) fall within that ownership as Derivative Works of the Platform Software. Our only rights are a non-exclusive, Field-of-Use licence that we may not modify (Article II(g)) or sublicense/transfer (Article II(c), Article VI) and that terminates with the Agreement (Article XXI). That fails the IP fallback: we have no perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense Deliverables for our business, and there is no limitation on Licensor's use of data we supply or that it processes for us. Licensor's retention of ownership in its own platform and know-how is acceptable and is preserved. We therefore propose the shortest fallback fix: a licence-back to the customization Deliverables plus a data-use limitation, inserted at the customization clause.

proposal.summary: Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence (use, modify, sublicense) to customization Deliverables we pay for, and limit Licensor's rights in our data to processing to provide the services.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We pay for the customization work but currently receive only a term-limited, Field-of-Use licence with no right to modify or sublicense, so we have added our fallback licence-back to those Deliverables and confined Licensor's rights in our data to processing it to provide the services. Licensor keeps ownership of the Licensed Technology and its know-how under Article III.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Articles II, III, VI and XXI, Licensor grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense for Licensee's business any customization or development work performed for Licensee under this Section (the "Deliverables"). Any licence or right of Licensor in data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Licensee is limited to processing such data solely to provide the services under this Agreement.
